data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that shows an expandable card with optional image or GIF background.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable expansion card that can display a title, content, and an optional animated image or GIF behind it. The card expands and collapses with smooth animation and allows styling of colors and icons.
use_when: You need a single expandable card with a visual background in a UI.
You want a quick, declarative way to add animated GIF or image backgrounds to an expansion tile.
avoid_when: You require a list of many expandable items or complex state management.
You need advanced animation control beyond simple expansion.
strengths: Simple API with many styling options
weaknesses: No built‑in list or multi‑item support
